conversation.user: My project is 300 square feet. How much hempcrete do I need?
conversation.assistant:
For a 300-square-foot wall area, you will typically need about 2.5 to 3 cubic meters of hempcrete material, depending on whether you are doing a 3-inch interior retrofit or a thicker application. Just keep in mind these calculator numbers are planning estimates and not stamped engineering advice. 

Are you planning to insulate an existing wall interior, or is this for a new build?
